points.title: Requester write Setup cycle
points.condition: i_apb_psel=1, i_apb_penable=0, i_apb_pwrite=1 at a requester clock edge

points.title: Requester read Setup cycle
points.condition: i_apb_psel=1, i_apb_penable=0, i_apb_pwrite=0

points.title: Write completes without error
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1, o_apb_pslverr=0, the transfer's Setup was a write

points.title: Write completes with error
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1 and o_apb_pslverr=1 for a write transfer

points.title: Read completes without error
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1, o_apb_pslverr=0, the transfer's Setup was a read

points.title: Read error with nonzero read data forwarded
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1, o_apb_pslverr=1, read transfer, o_apb_prdata nonzero

points.title: Completion after 8 or more requester wait cycles
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1 after at least 8 Access cycles with PREADY low

points.title: Completion after 32 or more requester wait cycles
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1 after at least 32 Access cycles with PREADY low

points.title: Completion after 128 or more requester wait cycles (long wait)
points.condition: o_apb_pready=1 after at least 128 Access cycles with PREADY low

points.title: Back-to-back Setup right after PREADY cycle
points.condition: Setup cycle (psel=1, penable=0) in the cycle immediately after a PREADY cycle

points.title: Back-to-back write then read
points.condition: Setup of a read immediately after the PREADY cycle of a write

points.title: Back-to-back read then write
points.condition: Setup of a write immediately after the PREADY cycle of a read

points.title: Back-to-back write then write
points.condition: Setup of a write immediately after the PREADY cycle of a write

points.title: Back-to-back read then read
points.condition: Setup of a read immediately after the PREADY cycle of a read

points.title: Setup after idle period of 4 or more cycles
points.condition: Setup cycle after at least 4 consecutive cycles with i_apb_psel=0

points.title: Error-free transfer following an error transfer
points.condition: PREADY with PSLVERR=0 where the previous transfer completed with PSLVERR=1

points.title: Consecutive error transfers
points.condition: PREADY with PSLVERR=1 where the previous transfer also completed with PSLVERR=1

points.title: Address all ones in Setup
points.condition: Setup cycle with every bit of i_apb_paddr high

points.title: Write with full strobes at word-aligned address
points.condition: Write Setup, all pstrb bits high, address bits 1:0 zero

points.title: Write with partial or zero strobes at misaligned address
points.condition: Write Setup, not all pstrb bits high, address bits 1:0 nonzero

points.title: Read with nonzero PSTRB forwarded
points.condition: Read Setup with at least one pstrb bit high

points.title: PPROT equal 0 in Setup
points.condition: Setup cycle with i_apb_pprot=3'b000

points.title: PPROT equal 7 in Setup
points.condition: Setup cycle with i_apb_pprot=3'b111

points.title: PPROT with a single bit set in Setup
points.condition: Setup cycle with i_apb_pprot one of 001, 010, 100

points.title: Requester changes fields during Access (Setup values must be used)
points.condition: Access cycle without PREADY where i_apb_paddr or i_apb_pwrite differs from the value of the Setup cycle

points.title: APB5 wake-up high at Setup
points.condition: PARA_APBCDC_APB5 nonzero, Setup cycle with i_apb_pwakeup=1

points.title: APB5 requester never drives wake-up at Setup
points.condition: PARA_APBCDC_APB5 nonzero, Setup cycle with i_apb_pwakeup=0

points.title: APB5 request user attributes nonzero
points.condition: PARA_APBCDC_APB5 nonzero, Setup cycle with i_apb_pauser nonzero, or write Setup with i_apb_pwuser nonzero

points.title: APB5 response user attributes nonzero at completion
points.condition: PARA_APBCDC_APB5 nonzero, PREADY with o_apb_pbuser nonzero, or read PREADY with o_apb_pruser nonzero

points.title: Requester-domain reset hit a transfer in flight
points.condition: First requester clock edge after i_rst_n_mst release when reset was applied while a transfer was in flight

points.title: Requester domain released while slave domain still in reset
points.condition: Requester clock edge with i_rst_n_mst=1 and i_rst_n_slv=0 (reset level, stable by protocol)

points.title: Completer-side write Setup
points.condition: o_apb_psel=1, o_apb_penable=0, o_apb_pwrite=1 on slave clock

points.title: Completer-side read Setup
points.condition: o_apb_psel=1, o_apb_penable=0, o_apb_pwrite=0 on slave clock

points.title: Completer ready in first Access cycle (no wait)
points.condition: Access cycle with i_apb_pready=1 and no preceding wait cycle

points.title: Completer wait of 4 or more cycles
points.condition: Access cycle with i_apb_pready=1 after at least 4 Access cycles with i_apb_pready=0

points.title: Completer wait of 32 or more cycles
points.condition: Access cycle with i_apb_pready=1 after at least 32 Access cycles with i_apb_pready=0

points.title: Completer error response at end of Access
points.condition: Access cycle with i_apb_pready=1 and i_apb_pslverr=1

points.title: Completer drives PREADY during Setup cycle (ignored)
points.condition: o_apb_psel=1, o_apb_penable=0 and i_apb_pready=1

points.title: Completer-domain reset hit a transfer in flight
points.condition: First slave clock edge after i_rst_n_slv release when reset was applied during a completer-side transfer
